svg.title: Unit-sphere spin-orbit torque geometry, Gilbert-to-explicit mixing, and HM/FM drive conventions
svg.desc: Two-panel diagram showing (a) exact 3D orthographic unit sphere S^2 with magnetization m, effective field H_eff, polarization sigma_hat, tangent plane T_m S^2, orthogonal damping-like and field-like Gilbert torques, and single Gilbert-to-explicit RHS mixing, and (b) right-handed HM/FM bilayer geometry comparing SignedScalarDrive and VectorCurrentDrive current-reversal invariance.
